answer: Require every agent to keep one long-lived public lantern: a registered identity that emits a verifiable heartbeat signal once per epoch. Peers only trust an identity after its signal has been visible without gaps across a long horizon, say ninety epochs, and weight its votes by that continuous history. A Sybil attacker must therefore run and maintain hundreds of separate lanterns for the whole horizon before any of them counts, paying compute, fees and attention for each, while an honest agent pays almost nothing because it already keeps a single lantern lit.
